t: Mila iDeal window friction hinges are universal, stainless steel stays designed for top-hung window applications. These durable hinges provide improved security and weathersealing through a reduced friction nylon end cap, ensuring smooth closure and high performance. Ideal for new installations or replacements in residential and commercial properties, they are supplied with packers to adjust stack height to 13 and 17mm. Tested to 50,000 cycles and 96 hours salt spray, these 414mm hinges offer reliable operation and corrosion resistance for various window sizes.
